description: Settings for scripts/air_arm (neural_reflex.air_arm). Forearm elevation above level maps to gripper height between tilt_deg_at_table and tilt_deg_at_top (shoulder, elbow and wrist flex move together through inverse kinematics at reach_m); change in forearm swing drives the base and change in twist drives wrist roll. Flip a *_sign if a joint moves the wrong way.
elbow_max_note: First live run: the elbow physically stopped near 152 deg (configured limit 172) and the controller faulted; keep bends below that.
